user.title: MySair
user.description: Sign in with your MySair account credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate MySair
reauth_confirm.description: The session for {email} has expired or is no longer valid. Enter your password again to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to MySair. Please try again later.

abort.account_mismatch: The account does not match the one originally configured. Reauthenticate with the same MySair account.

stop_installation.name: Stop installation
stop_installation.description: Stops an entire MySair installation (all its zones at once) using the backend's "stop" command. Different from turning off each zone individually with a switch or climate entity.

installation_ref.name: Installation reference
installation_ref.description: Reference (ctl) of the installation to stop, starting with "MYS". It is listed in the integration's diagnostics download.

data_description.allow_floor_cooling: Only enable this if the installation is designed for floor cooling and protected against condensation (dew point). When disabled, Home Assistant does not use the floor while the installation is cooling.

direction_locked.message: The installation is running in the other heat/cool direction. Turn off all zones first, then choose the new direction.

direction_unknown.message: The heat/cool direction of the installation is not known yet. Wait for the first status from MySair.

floor_cooling_disabled.message: Floor cooling is disabled in the MySair integration options.
